heat.t: biome about 590 kWh/m2·yr (London benchmark, not scaled); peak conduction about 100 W/m2 glass (Vancouver), 185 (Edmonton); set points 18-20 °C (wet tropics) or 12 °C (arid winter); supply ?; direct from a liquid loop, heat pump from an air-cooled hall; provisional. Daylit propagation house (heated benches): a low-temperature heat user, about 210-470 kWh/m²·yr at a 32.2 °C bench supply holding the root zone at 20-25 °C (Kim 2024, five-year root-zone heating study, trust 60); root-zone heat lets the air run 2-5 °C cooler, saving 20-50 % against air heating; the range is our arithmetic (trust 40). Seed room under grow lights: a small winter heat user, not a fixed heat figure: mostly electricity (an LED growing room uses 517-773 kWh/m²·yr measured, Manitoba vertical farm, trust 60; literature 850-1,150), a net heat source outside winter; at propagation light (DLI 10-12 mol/m²·d) LEDs run about 70-83 W per m² of bench, about 400-490 kWh/m²·yr of electricity (our arithmetic, trust 40)
heat.src: research §3 (our arithmetic); DECISIONS 12 Nov; propagation house: Kim 2024 root-zone heating study (trust 60), our arithmetic (trust 40); seed room: University of Manitoba thesis (mspace.lib.umanitoba.ca, trust 60), LED arithmetic (trust 40); (project decision, 21:33); (project decision, 21:40)
